'''Wicket33 Invasion Deck - under construction''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wicket33]]
* '''Published:''' 31 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Invasion
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Invasion Wicket33 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I'm attempting to build an Invasion deck, and could use some help in polishing it.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

I'm attempting a maximum drain deck without modifiers, plus being able to defend against other Naboo decks and Undercover. I've also tried to balance the destiny draws towards the higher end to allow for better damage. I'm new to the Battle Droid arena, so mabey an expert out there could help me out. Thanks.
